title: Cyberwave Simulation Engine
description: The engine a simulation run starts on: the `backend` of a start request. Defined in code by cyberwave_contracts.simulation.CANONICAL_BACKENDS, which a test keeps equal to this list. `mjwarp` is accepted on input as an alias of `mujoco_warp` and is never a stored value. Not the capability flag assets and twins carry in `supported_simulation_backends`; see common.simulation_backend.v1 and ENGINE_TO_CAPABILITY_FLAG for the mapping between the two.
